name: Mail Group
description: provides group email communication: mailing-list-style Mail Group entities with memberships, pluggable connection backends, and inbound message handling.
project_description:
Mail Group provides a way for site administrators to manage email groups. Users are added to groups, and when a message is sent to the group email address, all members of the group will receive it. Replies can be configured to go to the sender of the email, or to the entire group.

 Mail Group uses connection plugins to easily swap the method used for sending emails. A basic plugin that uses IMAP is provided with the module, with more options coming soon in add on modules. See the list below for the currently available options.

 Connection plugins available 
 
 Amazon SES 
 IMAP 
 Mailgun
